text: Your watch records the signals. Nura helps you see how they fit together.
Start with today's health score. Then look inside: sleep, activity, cardio fitness, and resting heart rate.
A single day is a snapshot. The twenty-eight-day view gives you a longer perspective.
Open a workout to follow your heart rate, and see how long you spent in each intensity zone.
Recovery compares readings with your own baseline. Sleep adds another part of the picture.
Move through your history. Put a day beside the weeks that led up to it.
Nura. See what's behind the number.
